ash: quick kick: we need a 72-hour rapid launch for the refapp— blog + 1 webinar + 3 short tutorials + benchmark snapshot. target next Thu. who can own what?

maria: I can do blog + social snippets. want a tight narrative: problem -> 5-min quickstart -> perf/cost box -> community CTA.

tess: webinar lead. propose 20min demo + 10min q&a. will turn recording into two 90s clips. need speaker list and runbook. Thu 1pm PT preferred.

noah: i'll run a short benchmark suite and give p50/p95 + cost/1k tokens. will call out batching vs nop-batch.

ash: routing: single form, tag=rapid_refapp, UTMs utm_campaign=rapid_refapp_launch. noah, can you add a tiny notebook link we can surface?

noah: yes. sample log: `2025-09-03 INFO p50=72ms p95=190ms tokens=512 cost_est=$0.15/1k`

maria: timeline: Wed EOD draft blog, Thu morning webinar dry-run, Thu publish + webinar. tess, can you invite ops?

tess: invited ops and eng. run-through Thu 9am PT.

devrel-bot: Checklist: [rapid-refapp-launch] blog, bench-notebook, webinar-runbook, hubspot-form, social-assets. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/launch-checklists/rapid-refapp

ash: perfect. i'll spin up the HubSpot form and post webhook. update thread when assets land. :rocket:
